title: EVENT 3.5 Anniversary Celebration Warm-up — Puzzle Challenge
lines: Rhodes Island will be celebrating its 3.5th anniversary soon, and Amiya has prepared a jigsaw puzzle with other operators in secret as a token of their gratefulness for Doctors' hardwork over the past six months. Please complete the tasks and unlock the puzzle pieces to accept this gift!
*For the best experience, please access the website on your PC with the browser window maximized.
Players can check the detail of each task on the task window.
Once a task is fulfilled, players can click on the corresponding puzzle piece to unlock it.

Once the unlocking progress reaches a certain threshold, a corresponding reward to all players across the EN Server will be unlocked. Players will be able to download the [Anniversary Celebration Puzzle Art] once all the pieces are unlocked.
This event and its rewards are meant for the whole EN Server. All rewards will be distributed via in-game mail within one week after the event concludes.
Unlock 1 Puzzle Piece : Persimmons Picked from a Scroll, Headhunting Permint*1, Manganese Ore*1
Unlock 3 Puzzle Pieces : Crisp Walnut Cookies, Headhunting Permint*1, White Horse Kohl*5, LMD*2100
Unlock 5 Puzzle Pieces : Spicy Hotpot, Headhunting Permint*2, Module Data Block*1, Chip Catalyst*2
Unlock 9 Puzzle Pieces : Puzzle Art, Golden Syrup New Year's Cake, Papaya Leaf Meat Pie, Orundum*2100

The final explanation of the event belongs to Yostar Games, the operation team of Arknights. If players find any violations against the rules or have any questions, please feel free to contact us: arknights.event@yo-star.com .
